cases.positive: Default ordinary nonShadow DEERLING stored0/no forced/month2/steps1, outside battle/storage, valid player/map/pokedex; normal media/messages, skip naming, no other changes: count→0 and core writes, then dynamic form1 commits/recalculates/registers seen form before normal owned/seen-egg. Resource requests use this dynamic form with their separate fallbacks.
reverse: month1 remains0, no seasonal setter; a nonnil forced form precedes getForm; battle/storage return stored form

front bitmap absence can be nil, cry absence can produce0/no play; do not equate all missing resources with the crack nil exception
cases.messages: Huh uses pause marker; hatch text sends empty leadingSE and wt80 (logical4sec, no wall-clock claim); scene name cleared before message; optional dex/nickname call sequence preserved. No new rich-text/name/number input contract.
cases.normal_return: With-music fade restores captured position/BGM/BGS after block normal return; outer fade ensure concerns fade/viewport only, not the inner music return or domain rollback.
cases.acceptance: Current scoped caller, original and EG-13/20 preserve the A053 distinctions and B04 per-entry media/message/normal-return limits. Full A053 acceptance still belongs to full R-B08 and actual gates.

receivers: WP16 foe count/type/location/default choice and normal-return cleanup
WP17 actual battle/contest messages, distinct from generic pbMessage
cases.positive: Active contest, selected one able player member,20 Sport budget/K, valid table/grass and passed trigger+allow, nonSafari, partner/force-single false, no radar/roamer/other override/plugin/layout residual, deadline not reached, normal defeat+return: partner gate precedes one-member false→two foes→ordinary partner/core→wrapper type2 with foe array; single-foe contest override not dispatched; no contest budget in/out or K contest-storage rewrite, no single-foe wild-end notification; ordinary after_battle heals player and partner because global partner exists.
reverse: No partner with one able player, or earlier force-single true, gives one foe; only with can_override and active contest/no previous handler does contest override use type0 and20 budget; budget writeback/0-ball announcer+judging are after normal wrapper return
Cave/fishing/surfing/indoor/outdoor location is separately selected; type2 is not cave location2, and partner/contest does not imply trainer type
Early trigger rejection, candidate/allow rejection, battle boolean false normal return, and wrapper exception are separate; no universal encounter cleanup/party healing/budget guarantee on exception

Wild BGM ignores foe contents/count/levels; nextBattleBGM > nonempty map wild > nonempty global wild > default. DefaultBGM host override/media gating/volume and memory consumption stay WP15/WP24 boundaries
cases.messages: Actual one/two-foe introduction is battle pbDisplayPaused→scene pause+skipAhead, not generic message resume; partner send-out follows that scene. Contest ball exhaustion announcer is only single-contest normal-return budget branch. Full battle UI/contest message catalogs not accepted here.
cases.normal_return: Wrapper normal return resumes BGM/BGS, clears memorized BGM+position and4 nextBattle presets, resets encounter step count, fades0.4 target and clears in_battle; step caller later clears encounter_type/sets trigger/reset forceSingle. No ensure guarantee; heal precedes wrapper after-yield cleanup.
cases.acceptance: The B04 receiver interpretation agrees with fixed B026 a/b/c and C003 EN16 narrowing; existing WP36 priority is preserved. WP53/B12 complete B026 correction and partner capture B013 remain outside this gate.
